objective: Repair mergeIntervals so a calendar can combine overlapping time ranges correctly.
rules: The input is an array of [start, end] integer pairs with start <= end. Return a new array of all ranges in ascending start order. Use half-open ranges: merge two ranges only when their interiors overlap. For example [1,3] and [3,4] stay separate. Ignore zero-length ranges. A range contained in another range must not shorten it. Do not mutate the input.

primaryMilestone.objective: Make mergeIntervals handle ranges supplied in any order.
primaryMilestone.rules: Make a sorted copy of the input before the existing merge loop, sorting by start. Keep the loop's behavior unchanged for this first stage. Do not mutate the input.
